parent.title: The React state stack for Itenium.Forge in 2026: the Redux question dissolves

siblings.title: Server-state layer for a React 19 + Vite SPA on a .NET API: TanStack Query wins
siblings.summary: TanStack Query is the correct server-state layer for itenium-ui; its Register.defaultError hook makes RFC 9457 ProblemDetails a first-class typed error with no per-call generics.

siblings.title: Client state after the query cache: Zustand vs Jotai vs RTK vs plain React 19
siblings.summary: Once TanStack Query owns server state, the residual client state in a CRUD admin is roughly one persisted preferences store — take Zustand's vanilla createStore in a shared Nx lib and skip the rest.

siblings.title: Generating the itenium-ui API client from Forge's OpenAPI document
siblings.summary: Orval is the pick for itenium-ui: it is the only generator that emits TanStack Query hooks, query keys, MSW mocks and Zod schemas from one config.

siblings.title: The router is a state manager: TanStack Router for itenium-ui
siblings.summary: Pick TanStack Router: it is the only option that makes filters/sort/pagination typed URL state instead of Redux slices.

siblings.title: Auth & session state for a React 19 SPA on Forge: kill the localStorage plan
siblings.summary: Drop the localStorage JWT plan: use react-oidc-context with an in-memory access token and put roles behind a /me query.

sources.title: Redux — Writing Tests

sources.title: Reselect
sources.claim: Reselect is the standard memoized-selector library for Redux derived state.

sources.title: redux-undo
sources.claim: redux-undo provides undo/redo by wrapping a reducer — the action log is the substrate.

sources.title: RTK Query — Code Generation

sources.title: Orval

sources.title: Hey API (openapi-ts)
sources.claim: Hey API generates a typed TypeScript client with a TanStack Query plugin.

sources.title: Zustand
sources.claim: Zustand is a minimal hook-based store with no provider, no reducers and no action types.

sources.title: TanStack Query

sources.title: Redux Style Guide
sources.claim: Redux ships an official Style Guide of enforced conventions.

sources.title: RTK Query vs TanStack Query (The Road to Enterprise)
sources.claim: TanStack Query replaces the server-state portion of Redux — often 60-80% of Redux code in data-driven apps.

sources.title: Redux DevTools
